AIRSPEED_MIN.reason: Replace wingless 9 m/s; 1.25 times a 14.4 m/s indicated stall speed. Not derived from a measured stall test.
AIRSPEED_MIN.condition: Illustrative 25 kg winged configuration ONLY: calibrated indicated stall speed <=14.4 m/s; replace from measured AUW/stall margin; corrected controls and real CG still required

Q_ASSIST_SPEED.reason: Enable assistance; MIN minus 3 m/s, above the assumed 14.4 m/s stall. In 4.7.1 -1 disables ALL Q_ASSIST triggers outside transitions.
Q_ASSIST_SPEED.condition: Illustrative 25 kg winged configuration ONLY: calibrated indicated stall speed <=14.4 m/s; replace from measured AUW/stall margin; corrected controls and real CG still required

AIRSPEED_CRUISE.reason: First steady-flight target near the existing 28 m/s true-speed test after density conversion; 25 indicated is ~27.38 true at rho=1.021.
AIRSPEED_CRUISE.condition: Illustrative 25 kg winged configuration ONLY: calibrated indicated stall speed <=14.4 m/s; replace from measured AUW/stall margin; corrected controls and real CG still required

AIRSPEED_MAX.reason: Automatic demanded-speed ceiling; 1.5 times the illustrative MIN=18. It is not an overspeed limiter and is not a requested test speed.
AIRSPEED_MAX.condition: Illustrative 25 kg winged configuration ONLY: calibrated indicated stall speed <=14.4 m/s; replace from measured AUW/stall margin; corrected controls and real CG still required; confirm attainable sustainable full-throttle level speed; no tests at 30 m/s or above

SCALING_SPEED.reason: Set the speed-scaling reference near cruise before the first fixed-wing tune; logged fixed-wing gains match the 4.7.1 defaults. Existing SITL tune uses 28 and cannot be transferred.
SCALING_SPEED.condition: Only with default/reset fixed-wing rate gains and a new tune; verify physical surface mapping first

Q_TRANS_FAIL.reason: Bound airspeed-wait time instead of indefinite transition; peer GreatShark also uses 20 s. Demonstrate acceleration to MIN within this time.
Q_TRANS_FAIL.condition: Validate real forward-thrust curve and timeout/abort in QuadPlane SITL

Q_TRANS_FAIL_ACT.condition: Validate QRTL approach, return path, home and battery reserve; QRTL can command fixed-wing flight when distant

Q_OPTIONS.reason: Add bit 0 level transition and bit 5 VTOL RC-failsafe QRTL; preserve bit 18 VTOL-only arming. Do not add bit 19 or 20.
Q_OPTIONS.condition: Review bitmask against fresh board export and rehearse QRTL; level transition restricts bank and VTOL climb response

ROLL_LIMIT_DEG.reason: Reduce maximum fixed-wing bank from 45 degrees for initial gentle manoeuvres; level-turn stall multiplier decreases from 1.189 to 1.050.
ROLL_LIMIT_DEG.condition: First-flight operating limit, not an aerodynamic structural limit

PTCH_LIM_MAX_DEG.reason: Reduce nose-up demand from 20 degrees while climb capability is unmeasured; matches present SITL angle envelope only.
PTCH_LIM_MAX_DEG.condition: Confirm sustainable climb and surface authority; FBWA does not regulate airspeed or altitude

PTCH_LIM_MIN_DEG.reason: Reduce nose-down demand from -25 degrees for the initial flight; matches SITL envelope.
PTCH_LIM_MIN_DEG.condition: Pilot retains throttle/speed responsibility in FBWA

PTCH2SRV_TCONST.reason: Use a gentler initial pitch demand than 0.5 logged / 0.2 SITL; both similar-aircraft reference files use 0.75. This is a demand-shaping choice, not a validated tune.
PTCH2SRV_TCONST.condition: Recheck actual pitch response before TECS/autonomous flight

RLL2SRV_RMAX.reason: Replace unlimited roll rate demand with 45 deg/s for the initial test.
RLL2SRV_RMAX.condition: Engineering starting limit; adjust from actual response

PTCH2SRV_RMAX_UP.reason: Limit upward pitch rate; approximately 560/25=22.4 deg/s per tuning guidance.
PTCH2SRV_RMAX_UP.condition: Rate-demand limit only; does not certify load factor or prevent stall

PTCH2SRV_RMAX_DN.reason: Apply the same initial pitch demand limit downward.
PTCH2SRV_RMAX_DN.condition: Rate-demand limit only; verify elevator direction and measured throw

FLTMODE3.reason: Expose QLOITER immediately before the FBWA slot.
FLTMODE3.condition: Verify actual six-position RC7 switch mapping and pilot bailout

FLTMODE4.reason: Expose FBWA for manual-forward-throttle first transition; do not start in CRUISE/AUTO.
FLTMODE4.condition: Wings and forward propulsion installed; surface/pusher direction checked

FLTMODE5.reason: Expose QRTL return mode after FBWA.
FLTMODE5.condition: Rehearse the return path and confirm switch positions

FLTMODE6.reason: Expose QLAND at the final switch slot.
FLTMODE6.condition: Verify mode selection on the actual radio

FS_LONG_ACTN.reason: Explicit RTL on long failsafe rather than continuing an automatic mode.
FS_LONG_ACTN.condition: End-to-end receiver/GCS loss tests; preserve FS_GCS_ENABL=1

Q_RTL_MODE.reason: Configure normal RTL to finish with VTOL return/landing instead of prolonged fixed-wing circling.
Q_RTL_MODE.condition: Return path validated with real aircraft geometry and propulsion

BATT_FS_LOW_ACT.reason: Replace warning-only with return, loiter down and QLAND.
BATT_FS_LOW_ACT.condition: Voltage calibrated and QRTL/return reserve demonstrated; these actions do not correct a bad current sensor

BATT_FS_CRT_ACT.reason: Restore QLAND action that was disabled inside log17.
BATT_FS_CRT_ACT.condition: Voltage threshold calibration and sufficiently clear emergency landing area

BATT_ARM_VOLT.reason: Restore the earlier minimum arming voltage from this same log; prevents treating the later 44 V allowance as a ready-to-fly standard.
BATT_ARM_VOLT.condition: 12S chemistry and actual voltage calibration confirmed; this is not a state-of-charge estimate

pending.ARSPD_RATIO: Determine from physical pitot installation/calibration; do not copy SITL or peer value.
pending.SERVOx_FUNCTION: Confirm direct vs inverse-V-tail mixing. Log17 has elevator19/rudder21 and all outputs9-16 disabled, so it does not establish a working CAN ruddervator setup.
pending.SERVOx_MIN/MAX/TRIM/REVERSED: Measure actual travel and direction. Log1100-1900 != SITL1000-2000; simulated elevator1575 trim is not a hardware trim.

pending.PTCH_TRIM_DEG: Retain logged0 until winged trim measurements; do not copy diagnostic -0.1485 deg.
pending.TECS_CLMB_MAX/TECS_SINK_MIN/TECS_SINK_MA: Measure sustainable climb/glide with real pusher and low battery; logged5/2/5 are unvalidated defaults.
pending.TECS_LAND_ARSPD: Set slightly above the final validated AIRSPEED_MIN before an automatic landing approach; do not invent a speed while MIN is conditional.
pending.RTL_ALTITUDE/Q_RTL_ALT/WP_LOITER_RAD/RTL: Location-dependent. Logged -1/15/60/0 does not define a reviewed first-forward-flight return path. At 25 m/s indicated and rho1.021, 25 deg bank gives ~164 m still-air radius. Start evaluating ~200 m loiter/return radius, 80 m return altitude and40 m VTOL return height in site-specific SITL, not as unconditional hardware values.
pending.INS_HNTCH_*: Log16 spectrum ~75-90 Hz warrants design work; log17 notch still disabled. Do not copy GreatShark75 Hz or Mugin51 Hz, or ESC-RPM mode with non-telemetry KDE ESCs.
pending.Q_M_THST_HOVER: Relearn with wings/pusher installed; retain last learned0.227437 as historical wingless value, not a prediction for winged25 kg.
pending.Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX/BATT_WATT_MAX: Remain0 until real propulsion-current measurement is calibrated; recent logged current is not total propulsion current.
